summary: Checked all nine requested contrast identifiers: eight existing estimates and the defended absence of s1_creativity_final_early_ai_labeled_vs_early_ai_unlabeled. Read the entire 320-line markdown conversion through the final references; the nine-page paper has no appendix. Extracted every cited PDF page (3-5), checked the source quotations and statistics, and inspected Figures 1 and 2 in memory. All non-null statistics in the eight estimates match the PDF and the specified outcomes and arms, including the positive printed d despite the negative t in the pooled labeling comparison. No numeric correction is required. Null analysis counts are justified: Section 3.1 reports the sample and allocations, but Section 3.6 reports screening without analysis-specific headcounts, and the reported ANOVA degrees of freedom do not resolve the discrepancy. The remaining outcome coding is supported, with unavailable AI availability retained as unknown. The eight problems are unresolved required question codes, not evidence for a particular replacement code; none can be resolved by guessing whether the early suggestions remained accessible. No missing eligible contrast was established under rules 4-6. In particular, Figure 2a has no creativity bracket between Early-AI-Labeled and Early-AI-Unlabeled; the early-only labeling bracket appears in the semantic-distance panel, whose estimate is present. The component creativity outcomes have only omnibus tests, not reported two-arm contrasts. Fixed-order within-arm changes, baseline measures, self-reports, moderation, and the preparatory pilot do not supply additional eligible estimates. checked=9 includes the requested absent contrast whose omission was independently verified.
